title: montiopsis berteroana
intro: Montiopsis berteroana, commonly known as Chilean rockrose or 'Sangre de Tormenta', is a species of flowering plant in the family Portulacaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and has been found to have potential health benefits such as wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which may aid in reducing pain and inflammation, as well as protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions attributed to Montiopsis berteroana include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
